title: Play AC Online messages file
description: Lines a script or another mod can use, by key. A script reads its own with message("key") and another mod's with message("author.mod:key"). This file cannot carry a $schema key, because every key is a line. Point your editor at messages.schema.json in its settings instead. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

additionalProperties.description: 1 to 400 UTF-8 bytes. Lines wrap by width, not by a count of characters. A row holds 180 pixels of the game's font, which is about 24 letters. Narrow letters like i and l take less room, and wide ones like W and m take more. A page holds 4 rows.
